card.title: The Designated Reminder
card.instruction: Keep track of what everyone was supposed to remember. Supply reminders before being asked and treat forgetfulness as your familiar burden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bin day tomorrow. I've written it on your breakfast banana.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll put another reminder on the coffee machine. Apparently I track breakfast now too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll set a phone alarm. You can stop leaving notes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll leave one by your charger reminding you what the alarm means.
